role: CI gate: no `AppDependencies.current` read (outside comment lines) in the files the composition root hands their dependencies explicitly (Emuqu/Sources/Services/AppLaunchTasks*.swift, DataPurgeService*.swift, ReanalysisService*.swift, and Emuqu/Sources/Collection/SessionReanalysisCoordinator*.swift, SessionScoringContext.swift), and no `AppDependencies.install(` call in either app target (Emuqu, EmuquWatch Watch App); install is for tests.
toplevel: cd to repo root; sources preflight. Expands each EXPLICIT_PATTERNS glob; a pattern matching no file -> exit 2. code_hits over those files for `AppDependencies.current` -> printed, status 1. Either app dir missing -> exit 2. grep -rn `AppDependencies.install(` over both app dirs minus comment lines -> printed, status 1. status 1 -> exit 1; else prints clean with the file count.

units.does: Prints `file:line:text` for each line of the given files matching the extended regex $1, dropping lines whose text starts with //, /// or *; always succeeds (empty output when nothing matches).
